description:
Call ONLY after the file(s) returned by update_data_spec have actually been uploaded (each PUT returned HTTP 200) — kicks off AI analysis and waits until the spec reaches "ready" or "failed". The upload is verified against storage first: if a file is missing this refuses, spends no credits, and hands back a fresh upload URL with the curl command to use. If it returns before the spec settles (timedOut: true), do NOT call this tool again just to keep checking — that re-attempts starting analysis. Poll with get_status (specId) instead until it reaches a terminal status.

Upload EVERY file update_data_spec listed before calling this. Analysis regenerates the parser and mapping from the spec's full stored input set, so a half-finished upload means the new files are combined with the old versions of the ones that did not make it — which produces a wrong mapping, not a failure. If an upload did not go through, go back and complete it first.

loadSampleData.description: Whether analysis should also trigger the data-load job (default true).

runAnalysis.description: Default true — set false to skip analysis and just confirm the upload.

specName.description: Name of the data spec being updated.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to act on. Defaults to your only workspace if you have exactly one.
